TotalSegmentator model bundle notice

This bundle contains the model files used by TotalSegmentator 2.14.0 for:

- task ID 115, craniofacial_structures / mandible; and
- task ID 297, the 3 mm total model used as the robust-crop helper.

Upstream project:
https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator

The application does not expose or distribute tasks listed by the pinned
upstream version as commercial models. The included task inventory records the
audited allowlist and upstream version. The model files are redistributed
without modification. The upstream Apache License 2.0 text is included in the
same legal directory.

This application and bundle are for non-clinical research and evaluation only.
